identity_lock.silhouette: Approved neutral endpoints and the two stable action keys preserve one standing proportion family with a broad head, compact body, planted feet, strap, satchel and one rabbit.
identity_lock.proportions: K07 and K09 are the action-family mother pair. Their full-body height, head/face dimensions, hem, legs and footwear must remain continuous with the neutral endpoints.
identity_lock.costume: Beret, rear bow, collar, ribbon, three buttons, navy dress, lace hem, socks, shoes, continuous strap, one satchel and one rabbit stay fixed.
identity_lock.rendering: Fine dark outlines, subdued ash-beige hair, smooth navy fabric, restrained warm shading and fixed front camera.

threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The head inclines a few degrees while feet and root remain fixed.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: Only the small head inclination changes silhouette area; no body-family change is allowed.
